articles.summary: Karman Space & Defense Secures $218 Million Agreement to Support THAAD Production. Karman Space & Defense (NYSE: KRMN) has entered into a seven-year, $218 million agreement with Lockheed Martin to provide shrouds for the Terminal High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD) program.
articles.title: Announcement October 20, 2026 Karman Space & Defense Awarded $218 Million Long-Term Agreement to Support THAAD Production
